conditions.evidence: studying treatment assessment in breast cancer
conditions.label: breast cancer

modalities.evidence: PET/CT data were acquired with a GE Discovery STE scanner

output.population: Breast cancer patients treated in the neoadjuvant setting, imaged at three time points before, during and after treatment.
output.summary: Longitudinal PET/CT, acquired prone to aid registration, together with quantitative MR images of breast cancer patients in the neoadjuvant setting, supporting development of quantitative imaging methods for early treatment assessment.
